brief: A finance analyst needs, from the checkout API log of that day, the number of checkout requests and the number of successful ones per hour (UTC), written as a CSV at `reports/checkout-hourly.csv` with columns `hour` (ISO 8601 hour start, for example 2026-03-17T14:00:00Z), `requests`, `succeeded`, sorted by hour, covering every hour present in the log. They also want the day totals as a one-line JSON file `reports/checkout-totals.json` with keys `requests` and `succeeded`. No analysis of why, no incident talk: just the counts. Count only checkout requests (not health checks or other paths), and count a request as succeeded when its status is below 400.
